newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Braathens SAFE starts six Oslo-Stockholm flights.
newsitem.headline: Braathens SAFE starts six Oslo-Stockholm flights.

text.p: Norwegian air carrier Braathens SAFE said on Thursday it would operate six daily flights between the Scandinavian capitals Stockholm and Oslo from November 6.
"We were granted nine slots in Stockholm but we could use only six of them because we could not get complementary slots in Oslo," Braathens spokeswoman Cathrene Pia Lund told Reuters.
"It's possible we will have more daily routes later."
Braathens SAFE said earlier this year it had applied to airport authorities to start up to nine daily flights between Oslo and Stockholm.
The carrier's fleet is made up of 25 Boeing 737-400s and 737-500s.
Braathens said earlier it would sell around 3.5 tonnes of cargo space on each flight.
